Shipper amount recovered vs importer path

A domestic mid-market shipper has no ocean D&D. Business-case year-1 example: fuel-surcharge recovery $16K (business case, EIA-based) + accessorial and detention invoice audit $24K (assumed) = $40K vs $52K for an importer = 0.77.

market-researcher research/02 and 05 (2026-10-17): $471.60 fee per power unit x 16.7 units = $7,895 per carrier at a 20% fee, so recovered = $7,895 / 20% = $39.5K. Built on assumed inputs (400 stops per truck, $100 per detained stop, 30% winnable); ATRI 39.3% detention rate sourced.
